page.layout: One title page, all lines centred in one block: woodcut ornament above, title lines, printer's imprint and date below, second woodcut ornament between them. Handwriting in the upper right and beside the ornament, a red seal at left, and a blue library stamp at right are not printed text and are not transcribed.
page.notes: A small mark (a dagger or asterisk-like sign) stands after "TORTI" in the second line of the title; it is not clearly a reference and is not transcribed. Handwritten annotations (upper right, and beside the lower ornament, including an attribution to "Lancelot Andrewes" and a shelfmark-like note) and a library stamp are excluded as not printed. The red seal and the decorative woodcuts are excluded.
